title: Freya and the Trail
author: E. M. Reyes
blurb: Yara Amberdale, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
